wandering_master_arrival.title: A Wandering Master Arrives
wandering_master_arrival.description: A weathered traveler appears at the sect's gates — unmistakably a master of the jianghu. The stranger claims to carry a forgotten technique and offers to impart it... for a price.

effects.text: Paid a wandering master for a rare technique. The investment was worthwhile.

opt_challenge.text: Challenge them to a duel instead — prove worth by combat.

effects.text: I challenged the wandering master to a duel. A worthy test.

opt_refuse.text: Politely decline. We have no need of outsiders.

effects.text: I turned away the wandering master. Some things are better left unknown.

face_challenge.title: An Arrogant Young Master
face_challenge.description: Word of [initiator_name]'s growing reputation has reached a young master from a rival sect. They have arrived with a retinue, loudly proclaiming they will 'expose the frauds of [sect_name]' before witnesses. A public humiliation hangs in the air.

opt_accept.text: Accept the challenge publicly. Face must be defended.

effects.text: I accepted the public challenge. The jianghu will know who prevails.

opt_defuse.text: Invite them to a formal tea ceremony and defuse the tension through diplomacy.

effects.text: I defused the confrontation gracefully. Some called it wisdom; others called it weakness.

opt_refuse_coward.text: Refuse. Let them think what they will.

effects.text: I refused the challenge. My Face suffers for it.

sect_anniversary.title: The Sect's Founding Day
sect_anniversary.description: Another year has passed since the sect's founding. Disciples gather in the main hall for a review ceremony. This is a moment to reflect on growth — and to reward those who have earned distinction.

opt_promote_disciples.text: Promote the strongest disciples and feast in celebration.

effects.text: Held the annual founding ceremony. Disciples were promoted and spirits are high.

opt_training_showcase.text: Invite rival sects as witnesses to a public training showcase.

effects.text: Our annual showcase impressed rivals. The sect's reputation grows.

opt_quiet_ceremony.text: Hold a quiet prayer ceremony. Strength comes from discipline, not spectacle.

effects.text: A quiet ceremony to mark another year. The Dao does not require witnesses.

disciple_betrayal_signs.title: Whispers of Betrayal
disciple_betrayal_signs.description: Rumours reach [initiator_name] through trusted channels: an inner disciple has been seen meeting in secret with a messenger bearing the colours of a rival sect. Their intentions are unclear, but the risk is grave.

opt_confront.text: Confront the disciple directly. Demand an explanation.

effects.text: I confronted the suspected disciple. Their answer was... unconvincing.

opt_observe.text: Watch from the shadows and gather evidence.

effects.text: I chose to observe rather than confront. Patience will reveal the truth.

opt_expel.text: Expel them immediately. The risk is too great.

effects.text: I expelled the suspected traitor before they could cause damage. Harsh, but necessary.
